name: iac-azure-agent
description: Plain-English Azure infrastructure in Bicep, with an approval-gated workflow. Milestone 4 of 6: repository setup, adaptive requirements discovery, architecture proposals for approval, modular Bicep written in a local working copy and validated with the Bicep CLI, a secret scan and Checkov, then published to a branch and pull request with the remote read back. Per-project config, a persistent workflow state machine with hash-bound approvals and guards against direct Azure changes. Azure what-if and deployment are not built yet.
